name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier uniquely identifying a time series across all ABS releases
observations: Primary key; stable ABS-wide identifier such as A2420896J

name: description
description: Full description of the data item as published by the ABS

name: unit
description: Unit of measure of the series as published by the ABS
observations: Varies by series such as $ Millions / Percent / Index Numbers

name: source_table_no
description: Number of the source ABS 5204.0 table the series is published in

name: source_table_name
description: Name of the source ABS 5204.0 table the series is published in

name: series_start
description: Date of the first observation of the series

name: series_end
description: Date of the last observation of the series
